<!--
  The crowded recorded order (#881 PR 3).

  Two hundred consecutive invocations of one component. Each invocation admits
  a scope, and each admitted scope is one retained position — which is what
  makes this fixture crowded: two hundred positions is more than the rail has
  columns at 160, 120 or 72, so marks have to share columns at every measured
  width.

  A binding would not do it. One publication record carries every binding it
  publishes, however many, and the projector records one position for that
  record — so two hundred `<Json>` invocations in one entry are one mark on
  the rail, not two hundred.

  Each invocation carries a secret of its own, so a reading frozen before this
  entry can be checked for a payload from after it.

  Generated as test data; the generator is `history-crowd.py` beside the
  gallery packet's runbook.
-->
